messages:
Ajay: Nightly CI just went red — integration-suite against hosted API. ~6 tests failing with 401 during streaming + tool calls. Anyone oncall to kick off rerun/bisect? :eyes:
CI Bot: Rerun requested by Ajay — queued shards: 3,5. Started: shard-3 (jid 9876).
Katie: i'm looking... saw a token-rotation change in PR #1289 merged 00:45 UTC. could be related.
Sam: can you paste a failing log? quick grep for '401' or 'invalid_token' would help.
Ajay: here are the failing traces from shard-3:
```
2026-03-16T23:12:01Z INFO request id=abc123 upstream=hosted-api
2026-03-16T23:12:01Z ERROR http: 401 Unauthorized - "invalid signature"
streaming: tool-invoke handshake failed, status=401
```
Ajay: notice 'invalid signature' — looks like keys mismatch on kid rotation.
Morgan: can someone confirm the JWKS url in test env? last deploy bumped the key version for hosted-api.
Katie: test env points at https://auth-staging.redwood/api/.well-known/jwks.json ok but the token issuer in tests still uses old kid.
Sam: i'll start a bisect across commits touching auth code and the infra deploys. @katie can you hold off merging anything to main?
Katie: yep holding. also adding a temporary skip for the most flaky streaming-tool test in nightly so block doesn't affect prod dashboards.
CI Bot: shard-3 rerun completed — 5/6 tests failed -> same 401s. shard-5 started.
Ajay: thanks. Sam, if bisect narrows to PR #1289+infra roll, we need a hotfix: either rollback key rotate or accept both kids in verifier.
Sam: running git bisect now across commit range 1220..HEAD focusing on auth/* and infra/deploy/*
Sam: quick update — bisect narrowed failure to commit 1291 (deploy script: bump jwks endpoint). reproducing locally against staging shows same 401.
Katie: confirmed 1291 changed jwks path to /api/v2/.well-known/jwks.json — tests still pointing to /api/ which explains invalid signature since staging serves old keys there.
Morgan: deploying a shim to redirect /api/ -> /api/v2/ on staging now, will notify when done.
CI Bot: shard-5 rerun result: 1/6 failed (same test). overall noisy but consistent single test failure.
Ajay: plan: 1) temp shim to restore compatibility (Morgan) 2) update tests to use canonical jwks path (Katie) 3) add verifier to accept both kids as immediate fallback (Sam) 4) open incident ticket and note rollback window.
Katie: creating ticket INF-572 and assigning to auth-team, referencing PRs and bisect logs.
Morgan: shim deployed, sanity check passed locally. pinging CI rerun now.
CI Bot: queued rerun for shards 3,5; will post results when complete.
Ajay: thanks all — if rerun green we can unskip the test and close the loop. if still red we'll escalate to eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
